source_issue.title: Build Storybook for a PR preview on `Aurora` branch

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue discusses the possibility of building Storybook for previewing pull requests (PRs) on the `Aurora` branch of Volto. Currently, any link to Storybook in preview PRs redirects to the stable version, which makes it difficult to view changes.

## What needs to be done
We need to explore how to configure the build process so that PR-specific Storybook URLs are generated instead of redirecting to the stable version. This involves potentially changing redirect settings based on notification of changes in relevant branches.

## Helpful background
The discussion indicates there may be uncertainties about the exact implementations needed to achieve this. The comments suggest some ways forward, but details on configuration may require further investigation, especially with integration in Read the Docs (RTD).

## Good first steps
1. Check the current configuration in `docs/conf.py` and `.readthedocs.yaml` for any redirect settings related to Storybook.
2. Review the existing documentation for Read the Docs related to building PRs.
3. Look into the links shared in comments for broader context.
4. Engage with team members in the next Volto meeting for additional insights and support.
```
